svg.aria-label: How Night Out runs a vote with no server. It finds bars, pubs, beer gardens and breweries on OpenStreetMap within 2.6 kilometers of you, and you pick 2 to 12 of them. The whole plan, the bars and the votes, goes into the link itself. A friend opens the link and votes, the link on their screen updates, and they send the new link back to the group. Every vote page ranks the bars by votes, and ties keep the order you picked them in. If friends vote on the same old link, a phone that opens both links keeps the higher count for each bar.
svg.text: Two friends vote on the same old link?
A phone that opens both keeps
the higher count for each bar.
